summary: Barns fitted out inside (hay, stalls, a cart, a workbench, tools on the walls) and farmyards with a tractor, a trough, implements, a churn stand and a hen house.
rationale: Appearance change seen when a barn's roof lifts and round every farm: matched studio rows of two barns with their roofs off and one closer, the farmstead in the seed-3 town views, and the yard's new pieces on their own.
